forwardEvents.subject: Herald call
forwardEvents.forwardOperation: At the sealed W01 absolute deadline, paid preparation+60000ms (60000ms), end B's active call/concentration. One automatic return attempt fails solely on occupied-volume overlap with TEST_ONLY_RETURN_BLOCKER_A at exact source anchor. Record returnOutstanding=true, release active reservation after outcome, retain Lumen body/cargo/HP/conditions/custody at actual destination; no retry, extension, forced placement or second body. Resolve this absolute clock at 60000ms before B's regular-start marker at the same offset.
forwardEvents.inverseOperation: Restore the active call at T0+59999ms for analytic replay, then reverse blocker movement, aid, failed A cast, B release, counter windows and B preparation in reverse order.

regularTurnLedger.phaseConvention: TEST_ONLY initiative assigns distinct ordered phase offsets within each six-second round. A regular slot ends after its own turn-end processing immediately before the next ordered participant's regular start; it does not overlap another participant and is not extended to start+5999ms. Equal-time starts, if any are introduced later, use initiativeOrder rank and are serialized end-before-start. Every regular start refreshes that actor's own budget exactly once. Absolute spell clocks resolve before a regular start at the same offset. Idle slots are explicit passes; actors already dead receive no later regular slot.

readyRuleBinding.sourceExcerpt:
## Ready

Spend an Action to declare a perceivable trigger and one legal Action-time action or movement. It expires next regular own-turn start. **NEW:** only one pending Ready per creature; replacing it loses the prior setup and any paid held-spell costs. No Bonus Action/Reaction ability, long ritual or multi-minute activity can be prepared by generic Ready.

The trigger happens first, then the readied response immediately follows before later events, unless a specific effect explicitly interrupts. On release spend the normal Reaction and recheck target, range, sight/perception, line of effect, ammunition and other prerequisites. An invalid or declined occurrence spends no release resource; the Ready can wait for another valid occurrence before expiry. This does not undo setup costs. Once released, it is consumed.

For ordinary nonspell actions, feature/ammunition costs are paid on release unless text charges setup. A readied **Attack Action** gets its legally available ordinary attack count; a feature limited to your own turn does not thereby work off-turn. Core Overwatch is explicitly one ranged attack, not that full Attack Action and not Soldier's distinct engine.

A readied spell is actually **cast at preparation**: choose spell/mode, verify legality, pay RP/material/other costs, provide components, resolve Dissonance/Refrain and cast-trigger effects once. Counterspell/cast-interruption opportunity occurs then, not again at release. Every held spell requires concentration, even ordinarily non-concentration spells; incompatible prior concentration ends. Lost concentration loses the held spell and costs. NEW: select the legal target/area point at release and recheck legality without repaying. At release the hold continues as ordinary spell concentration if required, otherwise ends after resolution. Expired/replaced/countered held spells do not refund paid costs.

Ready movement grants a separate current-Speed budget on release, pays terrain costs and can provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. It grants no extra Action, Bonus Action or interaction.

Focused stance's Reaction restriction also blocks an ordinary Ready release; Ready does not create a Counterspell exception. Holding a spell does not waive any current Reaction prohibition.

**Spell-effect duration begins at release.** Its normal duration is anchored when the effect manifests, while Ready expiry and held concentration already run from preparation. A source explicitly tying a particular consequence to casting/preparation retains that consequence's stated clock. No casting cost, Refrain, Dissonance or cast trigger occurs a second time merely from release.

rulesApplied.preparation: Ready spends the caster's Action, declares a perceivable trigger and casts the spell at preparation; verify legality, pay costs, provide components, resolve cast triggers and Counterspell opportunity once.
rulesApplied.hold: Every held spell requires concentration from preparation; Ready expires at the caster's next regular own-turn start.
rulesApplied.release: The trigger occurs first; the readied response immediately follows before later events. Release spends the normal Reaction and rechecks target and other prerequisites.
rulesApplied.targetAndClock: Select the legal target at release and recheck without repaying. A concentration spell continues as ordinary concentration after release. Preserve any sealed source-specific duration clock: Summon Herald W01 fixes its temporary-call deadline at paid declaration/preparation+60000ms. Ready release manifests the call at release but does not reset that deadline. In W04, preparation=0ms, release=1000ms, deadline=60000ms, leaving 59000ms active.
rulesApplied.counterspell: Counterspell opportunity occurs at preparation, not again at release.

eligibleWindows.windowTiming: Ready spell preparation cast; no second window at release
A's ordinary cast-start window; B then spends its still-available Reaction on the triggered Ready release

counterHistory.resourceOutcome: Both actual preparation/cast-start Counterspell windows are eligible and explicitly declined without RP or Reaction cost. B then spends its ordinary Reaction once on the Ready release; no new Counterspell opportunity occurs at release.

casterBStatus: Second test caster is explicitly hypothetical, separately individuated, not W17D or an actual campaign actor. It uses a correctly sourced Ready Action on an earlier ordered turn, holds its already-cast spell under concentration, then spends its ordinary Reaction at the exact later-turn trigger. Target selection and effect duration begin at release; the held concentration continues as the active call.
identityInvariant: At every step the unique registry contains one Lumen identity and at most one Lumen body. B's successful Ready release creates the single reservation; A's later failed admission adds no body, clone, projection or second reservation.
